language.label: Language
language.failedHint: The translations did not load. Nothing has changed, so try again in a moment.

connection.lostBody: Everything still works and nothing is lost. Reload when you can, and the screen will catch up.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That address does not match any screen.

apiError.notFound: That is not there any more. It may have been removed or renamed.
apiError.unauthenticated: You are signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
apiError.forbidden: Your role does not allow that. Ask an admin if you need it.
apiError.invalid: That could not be saved as it stands. Check what you entered and try again.
apiError.conflict: Somebody else changed this first. Reload to see where it stands now.
apiError.tableOccupied: Somebody has already opened that table. Its screen now shows where it stands.
apiError.visitNotOpen: That table has already been closed. Open it again to take another order.
apiError.visitNotClosed: That table is still open, so this cannot be done yet.
apiError.visitHasOpenBill: There is still an open bill on that table. Close the bill first.
apiError.visitHasUnbilledLine: A dish on that table is not on any bill yet.
apiError.lineNotQueued: Another chef marked that dish first. The ticket now shows where it stands.
apiError.lineNotReady: That dish is not waiting to be carried out.
apiError.lineNotServed: That dish has not reached the table yet.
apiError.lineNotVoided: That dish has not been cancelled.
apiError.roundNotReady: Somebody has already carried that ticket out.
apiError.billNotOpen: That bill has already been closed, so nothing more can go on it.
apiError.lineOnClosedBill: One of those dishes is on a bill that has already been closed.
apiError.billAlreadyClosed: That bill has already been closed. Its total is on the table screen.
apiError.billHasUnservedLines: A dish on this bill has not reached the table yet. Mark everything served first.
apiError.billHasNoLines: There is nothing on this bill to charge for.
apiError.billNotClosed: The bill has to be closed before a payment can be recorded.
apiError.sessionCollision: Signing in did not complete. Try again.
apiError.unavailable: The service is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
apiError.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
apiError.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
apiError.dishChanged: Somebody changed this dish after you opened it. The form now shows where it stands.
apiError.categoryChanged: Somebody changed this category after you opened it. It now shows the current name.
apiError.menuChanged: The menu changed while you were moving things. It now shows the current order, so try again.
apiError.categoryNotEmpty: That category still has dishes in it. Move or remove them first.
apiError.categoryArchived: That category has been removed. Choose another one.
apiError.nameTaken: Something on the menu already has that name. Rename one of them first.
apiError.dishNotOrderable: A dish in the basket has just gone off. It is marked below; take it out to send the rest.

account.title: Your account
account.languageHint: What you read the app in, on every device you sign in on.
account.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
account.passwordHint: Changing it signs you out everywhere else, and leaves you signed in here.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.signOutHint: Signs out this device only. Anywhere else you are signed in stays signed in.

fieldError.invalid_format: That is not in the right form.
fieldError.unknown_country: That is not a country this platform serves yet.
fieldError.not_in_catalogue: That is not a language this platform offers.
fieldError.too_large: That is more than this can hold.
fieldError.too_many_decimals: That has more decimal places than your currency uses.
